recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is recommended for FHIR-11284 unless the Imaging Integration work group later chooses to edit generated diagram tooltips or reintroduce explicit procedure-code value-set guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-11284 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for a DSTU2 ImagingStudy ballot comment. It asked the diagnostic-request definition to recognize that radiology services can use one procedure code for combined procedures and that RSNA/RadLex/LOINC procedure names can encode body-site structure. The final resolution said RadLex/LOINC are only potential value sources, many sites use local value sets, the current build no longer referenced LOINC, and existing text supported multiple levels of procedure-code granularity.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-11284 or GF#11284 was found. The surrounding 2016-2017 ImagingStudy history shows the issue family was addressed by keeping grouped-procedure requirements text on ImagingStudy.basedOn and by adding separate procedureReference/procedureCode elements in commit d6c6d61a. The adjacent FHIR-11285 application commit b838ed23 removed the old LOINC radiology orderables comment from ImagingStudy.procedure.
additional_context: ImagingStudy is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source has a broader ImagingStudy.basedOn definition with a comment that one imaging study may be based on multiple ordered procedures, including chest/abdomen/pelvis CT, and the DICOM mapping includes Requested Procedure Code Sequence. Later R6 procedure-family issues FHIR-50894, FHIR-52026, and FHIR-53025 changed how requested and performed procedures are modeled; FHIR-53025 is already represented on the combined branch and establishes the current ImagingStudy.procedure behavior. A stale generated-looking SVG tooltip still contains the old diagnostic-request wording, but the authoritative XML source is correct and an SVG-only edit is outside this reconciliation threshold.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was needed because current build-scope ImagingStudy source avoids RadLex/LOINC-specific procedure-code recommendations, supports grouped requested procedures at ImagingStudy.basedOn, separates requested orders from performed Procedure references, and reflects the later R6 decisions that supersede the old DSTU2 element shapes.

related_jiras.note: Adjacent ballot issue removed the ImagingStudy.procedure LOINC radiology orderables comment, reinforcing that FHIR-11284 should not add RadLex/LOINC-specific guidance.
R6 issue temporarily moved performed procedures from ImagingStudy.procedure to partOf, affecting interpretation of later procedure-family source.
R6 issue corrected the Imaging Study Procedures note so requested procedures are represented by ServiceRequest, not ActivityDefinition.
Later Applied issue reversed FHIR-50894 and is already represented on the combined branch; it establishes current ImagingStudy.procedure behavior for performed procedures.
